Recipe.Description: Shredded potatoes, fried to a crisp.

Method.Step: Place shredded potatoes in a bowl lined with a colander, or a salad spinner. Cover with cold water. When water becomes cloudy, drain and repeat until water is mostly clear.
Combine potatoes and salt, let sit for about five minutes.
Roll up towel, then wring as much water from the potatoes as you can.
Unroll the towel and fluff the potatoes.
Spread the potatoes to cover the center 1/3 of the towel. Fold the towel to cover the potatoes and microwave for 2-4 minutes, until potatoes start producing steam.
Heat a shallow skillet over medium heat. Add a tablespoon of butter, swirl it around and add half of the potatoes, spreading them out into a circle. Season with pepper, onion powder and MSG.
Cook over medium heat, without messing with them, until the edges are browned and crisp.
Slide hash browns onto a plate. Add another tbsp of butter to the pan. Flip the plate into the pan. Continue cooking until browned and crisp.
